Who is heaven's inaugurator? You raise your own crown with arms unweighted, but wherefore royalty's exaltation is minted must you be credited to God's mystery. Wisdom's silent dawn brings the chorus of Truth to the ears of one who truly walks alone - and yet singing in praise, so sweet and sure, is all Life, varied beyond measure. The lauding of this grandeur is the greater part of all humble hearts; the reception of this grandeur is the divine decommission of all parts and partialities in the hearts humble magnitude. Glory to God is grace to the giver.
